title: Minimize build latency and image bloat via layered cache profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Full CI runs and image builds are a major contributor to our platform iteration cost — median full build time for the monorepo is ~38m and several runtime images are >1.2GB. We have inconsistent Dockerfile patterns across services and ad-hoc BuildKit cache usage which leads to frequent cold builds and large image layers.

Goal: Reduce median CI full-build time by 30-45% and shrink production runtime image sizes by at least 25% across the most critical services (api, runtime, web). Achieve consistent remote build cache hit rates >=85% for merged-by-default pipelines and create a repeatable pattern for future services.

Scope: Standardize base image choices and multi-stage layouts, introduce environment-aware cache profiles (fast-local, ci-remote, release-optimized), centralize BuildKit/Buildx invocation in the shared build scripts, and upgrade lint/toolchain containers (eslint, golangci-lint, cargo) to supported versions while keeping build hermeticity.

Non-goals: This ticket does not migrate the entire monorepo to a new build system (Bazel/Nix). It avoids changing language runtime versions (Go 1.20, Node 18) unless necessary for a toolchain security fix.
comments: 2026-02-19 — Kickoff: Aligned with infra and platform on goals. Agreed to run a two-track pilot: (A) image slimming for api + runtime images, (B) build cache for CI pipelines using remote S3-backed BuildKit cache. Action items: produce current baseline artifacts and cost estimate. — Aisha

2026-02-24 — Baseline report: Collected full-build traces for 5 recent merges. Findings: repeated npm install and go module downloads cause 40% of variability; Dockerfiles often re-install deps after copying source which busts cache. Estimated cost savings of ~$14k/year if cache hit rates improve to 85%. Uploaded baseline trace: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/CI-Baseline-ENG-20987

2026-03-01 — Design decision: Use multi-stage distroless-ish runtime images for Go/Rust services and node:slim for frontend build stage only. We will not convert to scratch images in this ticket due to debugging cost. Chosen remote cache: s3://redwood-buildkit-cache with per-branch keying. Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Layered-Cache-Profiles

2026-03-03 — PR created: GH #4321 adds a shared buildx wrapper (scripts/buildx.sh) and introduces three cache profiles (fast-local, ci-remote, release-optimized). Pilot targets: api-service and runtime-service. Requested reviewers: Marcus, Priya. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 — Marcus

2026-03-06 — Early results: First CI runs with ci-remote profile show cold-builds ~10% slower due to cache restore, but warm builds improved median pipeline time from 38m -> 21m for the api-service. Noted an edge-case where node_modules are invalidated by non-deterministic package-lock rewrites; created follow-up ENG-21012 to pin lockfile behavior.

2026-03-09 — Lint/toolchain upgrades: Migrated golangci-lint to 1.59 in the lint container and added a reproducible cache layer in the Dockerfile. Ran into transient failures on CI image due to changed default linters; disabled 'gofmt' check temporarily and opened GH #4350 to add automated rule upgrade notes. — Priya

2026-03-11 — Security review: Security flagged that remote cache endpoint requires signed URLs + per-repo ACLs. Implemented short-lived S3 PUT credentials via token-service and updated the build wrapper to fetch credentials on-demand. Security review required: true. — Security

2026-03-12 — Blocker discovered: runtime-service image size decreased by 28% but some init scripts rely on bash which distroless images do not include. Decision: switch to minimal busybox layer in release-optimized profile for runtime-service to retain compatibility. Update planned in GH #4382. — Marcus
